label: Raise
tooltip: What BOCCHI does when you are KO'd in Occult Crescent and another player raises you.

auto_accept_raise.label: Auto-accept raises
auto_accept_raise.tooltip:
On: when someone raises you in Occult Crescent, accept the prompt right away.
Off: accept or decline the prompt yourself.

say_thanks_after_raise.label: Say thanks after being raised
say_thanks_after_raise.tooltip: After an auto-accepted raise brings you back, send the message below in /say.

thanks_message.label: Message
thanks_message.tooltip: Sent in /say once you are back on your feet. Leave empty to send nothing.
